verdict.rationale: Sentry ships its own natural-language interfaces. Seer Agent answers free-form questions about an application from telemetry. The official MCP server lets AI assistants search errors, analyze performance, triage issues, and manage projects through conversational commands. missing for 10: detailed docs on which actions can be performed by natural language inside Sentry's own UI (Seer Agent is shown answering questions rather than executing commands), and independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works as claimed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Ask any question about your application and Seer Agent finds the right telemetry to answer it.
Connects AI assistants to Sentry for searching errors, analyzing performance, triaging issues, reading documentation, and managing projects — all via the Model Context Protocol.
Assign Sentry Agent to Linear issues, debug with Seer.
